segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report mixed results: some describe irritation, stinging, dryness and peeling (especially when rosemary oil bothers them), while others say it left skin soft, hydrated and not stripped.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report good tolerance (no irritation, calming feel, safe for eczema/psoriasis-adjacent skin) but a few report stinging, worsened dryness and breakouts.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it removes excess oil without drying the skin, though one notes new breakouts despite normally clear skin.
segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers report it removes makeup well without leaving a greasy or oily after-feel.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin say it cleanses without stripping or tightening and leaves skin soft; one reviewer in a cold dry climate credits it with keeping skin hydrated, though one dry-skin reviewer says it made her skin very dry and peeling.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing eczema, psoriasis or a compromised barrier are split: one with eczema says it removes makeup without irritating her barrier, another with psoriasis-related dry patches says it made her patches ten times worse.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no new breakouts and even fewer breakouts with regular use; a few report the opposite, citing new pimples, cystic-feeling breakouts or a full breakout they attribute to the oils or rosemary oil in the formula.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it cuts through oil and makeup without leaving a residue or oily film, though a couple of other reviewers describe an oily residue left after rinsing.

aspects.libelle: Thick balm slow to melt or emulsify
Struggles with waterproof mascara and heavy makeup
Blurs vision or stings eyes temporarily
Bulky wasteful packaging relative to product amount
Good value, lasts a long time per jar

extraits.texte: So I've been on the hunt for a cleansing balm that is microplastics free, and this is one that came up so I decided to try it. Um, it's really really thick. Not in a good way like the "oh this'll melt into the skin really nice and remove everything" way, but in a bad way like "oh crap I forgot my squeezy tube lip balm in my car in the middle of winter and now I need to put it in my bra for five minutes to warm it up" way. And even then it STILL doesn't melt enough. You'd think that with it being so thick, it would at least melt everything away, right? Wrong! It doesn't remove makeup that well, and I don't wear a ton of makeup. I've used it on heavy makeup days, light makeup days, and days where all Ive put on is sunscreen, and it's never really felt totally clean, and I would have to double cleanse with my regular cleanser, which because I have very dry and sensitizing skin I don't use a gel cleanser, I use a cream cleanser. It also takes a long time to wash off completely, and even when it's washed off completely the smell of it lingers. A lot of people have said it smells like Vicks and it kind of does, but I feel it smells more like Amrut Malam which is an Indian ointment which is used for everything by Indians in the same way Latines use Vicks (I'm Indian and Latine, so these have been staples in my house and while they do smell similar, it's still a very different scent.) Anyways, whether it smells more like one or the other isn't that important, it just smells medicinal

Somehow over looked the rosemary essential oil when I was reading the ingredients. I think this product would be so much better without it because the rest of the ingredients are fine. It made my skin really dry and super irritated, it would sting to put my products on after (and my products are amazing, all acne-safe and super hydrating, all recommended by my esthetician and I have been using them for years but wanted to look for a cheaper pre-cleanse). Now I have some tiny pimples around my cheeks and chin, and I'm peeling. Luckily the rest of my routine is solid so that helped keep this under control cause I think it could have been a lot worse otherwise.

I used this product as a balm to remove my makeup and first off it smells exactly like vicks vaporub. second it literally irritated my face so bad. I have dry patches under my eyes and on parts of my face from psorasis and this made it 10x worse. Please do not buy it, go with the elf removing balm, its cheaper also.

I have mixed feelings about this cleanser. I have been using this cleanser for a couple days now. For starters i have combination skin. So, what i do like about it is it takes out all the excess oil my skin builds up throughout the day without it making me feel dry. What i don't like about it is i have super clear skin, but i am starting to believe this product is making me break out. i got 3ish - 4 pimples in one day and MIND YOU i rarely break out. I guess breaking out is bretter than being allergic to it.. It does have a stinky smell and i was worried the smell would stick to my face but it honestly doesnt.

extraits.titre: amazing for my sensitive skin barrier
extraits.texte: I have eczema and sensitive skin and this product takes my makeup off without a fuss and leaves my skin feeling so soft < 3

Wow — this is an absolute must-have for anyone who wears eyeshadow or mascara! This remover truly gets all your makeup off. Seriously, just rub it on, and you can even leave it for a couple of minutes while you do other things before rinsing — it takes off every bit of eyeshadow and makeup. The texture feels amazing on the skin, and it's so gentle. I'm completely obsessed! This is hands-down the best makeup remover I've ever used, and I highly recommend it. Btw, I have dry, sensitive skin and have had no problems for two months. Thumbs up. Highly recommend. Love the consistency!

I have had life long acne prone skin that is a combination of dry and oily. This is the best facial product that Ive ever used and Ive used hundreds. Most oil cleansers that I have used strip my face and make it dry. This silky feeling balm doesnt do that. It melts away my heavy eye make up, spf and concealer in seconds. Washes away clean with zero residue. Non drying. My skin is soft and clearer than ever. I often combine this with good molecules pineapple exfoliating powder and the combo is phenomenal. I follow up with magic molecule spray. I love this and will buy it over and over again.
